### Fixed
- **The classic vLLM runtime runs its container through the llm-d template's argument grammar, so every shipped preset serves on the classic `InferenceService` path too** (giantswarm/agent-platform#549). The chart's `kserve-vllm` `ClusterServingRuntime` — the path model-manager composes into wherever the `LLMInferenceService` API is not served — put a preset's arguments straight into argv, while the presets write every JSON-valued vLLM flag single-quoted inside one argument (`--limit-mm-per-prompt='{"image": 1, "video": 0}'`, giantswarm/agent-platform#532) because the llm-d runtime template re-parses its arguments with a shell; vLLM received the single quotes literally and refused the value (`invalid loads value`), so the six presets with such a flag could not start on the classic path, and a bare JSON that would have worked there fails the chart's argument guard. The runtime container now has the command `/bin/sh -c 'eval "exec vllm serve $@"' --` ahead of its base arguments (`modelServing.runtime.args`, unchanged: `--model /mnt/models --port 8080 --served-model-name {{.Name}}`, KServe still expands `{{.Name}}` before the container starts); KServe appends the preset's arguments after them, so `$@` is base + preset and a single-quoted JSON value reaches vLLM as one word with the quotes gone — exactly as on the llm-d template, one grammar for presets. The image must carry `/bin/sh` and `vllm` on `PATH` (the upstream vLLM images do; an installation's own `modelServing.runtime.image` must too). `make verify-serving-slice` now also runs the RENDERED classic command over the rendered base arguments and every shipped preset's, with a `vllm` stub dumping argv, and asserts the base arguments (the `{{.Name}}` placeholder expanded the way KServe does, an installation's extra ones) and the preset's reach vLLM one word each with every JSON value parsing on both paths, so the two cannot drift again; the fixture pod of `verify-model-serving-policies` carries the command. Not changed: a preset's argument rule (single-quote a value with whitespace or JSON; the render refuses the rest), the base arguments, the port, the image.
- **The shipped presets serve on the llm-d runtime: a JSON-valued vLLM argument is one argument with the JSON single-quoted inside it, and the chart refuses a preset argument the runtime's shell would re-split** (giantswarm/agent-platform#532; proof 1 of giantswarm/giantswarm#37639). The well-known runtime template's entrypoint (`kserve-config-llm-template`, from the kserve-runtime-configs chart) ends in `eval "exec vllm serve … $@"`: every argument is re-parsed by the shell, so `--default-chat-template-kwargs` followed by `{"enable_thinking": false}` reached vLLM as `{enable_thinking:` and `false}` — `invalid loads value`, CrashLoopBackOff — and `qwen3-8b-fp8` could not be served; `qwen3-14b`, `qwen3-5-27b`, `qwen3-5-35b-a3b`, `nemotron-3-super-nvfp4` and `qwen3-8-27b` (three such arguments) carried the same shape. The six presets now write each such value as `--flag='{…}'`, which the shell's re-parse yields as one word with the JSON intact. The connectivity chart's `resolvePreset` fails the render of any preset — shipped or `modelServing.presets` — whose argument carries whitespace, a quote or a shell metacharacter outside single quotes, naming the preset and the argument; the preset schema's `spec.args` states the contract. `make verify-serving-slice` runs the template's exact eval over every shipped preset's arguments (argv dumped in place of vLLM) and asserts one word per argument and a parsing JSON value, and that seven bad argument shapes fail the render naming the guard. The classic `InferenceService` path gets the same grammar in giantswarm/agent-platform#549 (below).
